title: 8 Best Hedge Accounting Software Tools in 2026
summary: Compare the 8 best hedge accounting software tools in 2026, from Chatham and Kyriba to AI agents like Concourse, by workflow coverage, valuation, fit, and cost.
body_markdown:
Hedge accounting is one of the most technical corners of the finance function, and it just got a refresh. In November 2025 the FASB issued[ASU 2025-09](https://rsmus.com/insights/financial-reporting/fasb-issues-asu-hedge-accounting-improvements.html) , which relaxes several ASC 815 constraints and takes effect for public companies for periods beginning after December 15, 2026. That change, plus ongoing FX and interest-rate volatility, is sending finance teams to reevaluate their **hedge accounting software** .


The category is not one thing. Some tools are advisor-led services, some are modules inside a treasury system, some are valuation engines, and a new AI-agent layer automates the workflow around all of it. This guide compares the eight best hedge accounting software tools in 2026 across those types, so you can match one to how your team actually works.


## **What hedge accounting software does**


Hedge accounting is an elective treatment that lets you match the P&L timing of a hedging instrument with the exposure it hedges, reducing earnings volatility. To qualify, you have to satisfy strict, ongoing requirements under ASC 815 (US GAAP) or IFRS 9 (international). Hedge accounting software automates that workflow:


- **Designation and documentation.** Capturing the risk-management objective, hedged item, instrument, and hedge ratio at inception.
- **Effectiveness testing.** Prospective and retrospective testing using methods like critical-terms match, dollar-offset, regression, and the hypothetical-derivative method.
- **Derivative valuation.** Fair-valuing OTC derivatives, often with CVA/DVA under ASC 820 or IFRS 13.
- **Journal entries and disclosures.** Posting to the ERP and producing the footnote and reporting support.


## **What is the best hedge accounting software?**


> The best hedge accounting software depends on whether you need software, valuation, or a full managed service. Chatham Financial, Kyriba, and GTreasury (Hedge Trackers) offer end-to-end hedge accounting under ASC 815 and IFRS 9; Bloomberg MARS provides the valuation-plus-testing layer; Hedgebook fits SMEs; Derivative Path suits banks and interest-rate hedgers; and Concourse is the AI-agent option that automates the surrounding workflow, documentation, journal entries, reconciliation, and disclosure prep, alongside a specialist valuation engine.


## **How we evaluated hedge accounting software**


- **Workflow coverage.** How much of the lifecycle it handles, from designation through disclosures.
- **Valuation.** Whether it prices derivatives itself or needs a feed.
- **Effectiveness testing.** Which methods it supports.
- **Software vs. service.** Pure SaaS, or software paired with CPAs and advisory.
- **Integration.** How cleanly it posts to your ERP and connects to treasury data.
- **Standards and fit.** ASC 815, IFRS 9, and the company size it targets.

## **The 8 best hedge accounting software tools in 2026**


### **1. Concourse, Best for Automating the Hedge Accounting Workflow**


Concourse is the AI-agent option on this list, and the scope matters: it is not a derivatives-valuation engine or a regulatory-grade effectiveness-testing model. What it does is automate the workflow *around* hedge accounting, the repetitive, connective work between treasury and accounting that consumes analyst time. Its agents assemble and maintain hedge documentation, prepare the inputs for effectiveness testing and organize the results, generate and route journal entries into your ERP, reconcile derivative positions and valuations across systems, and draft the disclosure tables auditors ask for, with every output traceable to source and a person approving.


It connects to 100+ systems including NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Snowflake, is SOC 2 Type II certified, and works in ChatGPT, Claude, Slack, Teams, and email. This is the cash-desk and treasury-analyst work we describe in[the AI treasury analyst](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/ai-treasury-analyst) , applied to the accounting around hedges.


**Best for.** Finance teams that want to automate the documentation, journal-entry, reconciliation, and disclosure work around hedge accounting, alongside a valuation engine or specialist.


**Keep in mind.** Concourse does not price derivatives (MTM, CVA/DVA) or make the ASC 815 designation and effectiveness judgments. Pair it with a dedicated valuation engine or hedge accounting specialist for those.


### **2. Chatham Financial, Best for Advisor-Led Programs**


Chatham Financial, through its ChathamDirect platform, is one of the most established names in hedge accounting, pairing software with in-house advisory (CPAs, quants, and lawyers) to run OTC FX, interest-rate, and commodity programs end to end. Founded in 1991, it[serves thousands of clients worldwide](https://www.chathamfinancial.com/industries/corporates) .


**Best for.** Corporates that want an advisor-led hedge accounting program, not just a tool.


**Keep in mind.** It is an advisory-led model rather than pure self-serve SaaS, so it skews to the service-heavy, higher end.


### **3. Kyriba, Best for Full-TMS Corporates**


Kyriba embeds hedge accounting in its full treasury platform: FX exposure aggregation, mark-to-market, designation and documentation, effectiveness testing, and automated entries in one system, per its[derivative and hedge accounting fact sheet](https://www.kyriba.com/resources/fact-sheets/derivative-hedge-accounting/) . It reports 3,400+ corporate clients across roughly 170 countries.


**Best for.** Mid-to-large corporates already running or adopting a full cloud TMS with active FX or commodity programs.


**Keep in mind.** Hedge accounting is one module of a broad, enterprise-priced platform. See our[Kyriba pricing](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/kyriba-pricing) breakdown.


### **4. GTreasury, Best for Software Plus Outsourced Execution**


GTreasury automates the hedge accounting lifecycle from exposures to disclosures through Hedge Trackers, the specialist software-and-consulting firm it[acquired in 2022](https://treasuryxl.com/blog/gtreasury-acquires-hedge-trackers-the-global-leader-in-hedge-accounting-software-and-consulting/) . It pairs software with optional advisory and SOX-compliant controls.


**Best for.** Companies that want software plus outsourced execution to reduce key-person risk.


**Keep in mind.** Confirm whether you are buying software, services, or both.


### **5. Bloomberg MARS, Best for the Bloomberg Ecosystem**


Bloomberg's[MARS Hedge Accounting](https://professional.bloomberg.com/products/risk/mars-hedge-accounting/) runs on the Terminal and API with a common pricing library, supporting critical-terms match, shortcut, dollar-offset, scenario, and regression testing, and integrating with MARS XVA for CVA/DVA. It is a valuation-plus-testing engine as much as a hedge accounting tool.


**Best for.** Firms already in the Bloomberg ecosystem that want valuation and effectiveness testing together.


**Keep in mind.** It assumes you live on the Terminal, and is strongest as the valuation and testing layer rather than a full workflow-and-disclosure tool.


### **6. Hedgebook, Best for SMEs**


Hedgebook is an affordable, SME-focused platform for FX and interest-rate hedge tracking, valuations, and hedge-accounting effectiveness support, covering IFRS 9 and IFRS 13 including CVA/DVA. Founded in 2011, with[offices in New Zealand and the UK](https://hedgebook.com/about-hedgebook/) .


**Best for.** SMEs and mid-market treasuries stepping up from spreadsheets without enterprise pricing.


**Keep in mind.** Built for the SME and mid-market, not the most complex enterprise programs.


### **7. Derivative Path, Best for Banks and Interest-Rate Hedgers**


Derivative Path's DerivativeEDGE handles interest-rate and FX derivative trading, servicing, and hedge accounting front to back, with ASC 815 documentation, testing, and journal automation. Founded in 2013, it[raised $35 million from FTV Capital in 2020](https://ftvcapital.com/2020/derivative-path-raises-35-million-in-growth-equity-funding-from-ftv-capital/) and serves 130+ institutional clients.


**Best for.** Banks, financial institutions, and end-users managing interest-rate and FX hedges, including non-vanilla structures.


**Keep in mind.** Strongest on the financial-institution and interest-rate side; confirm depth for pure-corporate FX or commodity needs.


### **8. Reval, Best for ION Treasury Customers**


Reval pioneered SaaS derivative and hedge accounting and is now part of ION Treasury, offered within ION's portfolio and as Reval Center, an[outsourcing service for valuations and hedge accounting](https://iongroup.com/resource-center/treasury/reval-center/) . Reval was acquired by ION in 2016.


**Best for.** Existing ION Treasury customers and firms wanting outsourced valuation and hedge-accounting support.


**Keep in mind.** Reval is now a brand inside ION rather than an independent product, so evaluate current ION packaging.


*Also worth a look:* Numerix and FINCAD (a valuation engine that sits behind a hedge accounting process), HedgeStar (outsourced software-plus-CPAs), and FIS Treasury and Risk Manager (hedge accounting inside a full enterprise TMS).


## **Which hedge accounting software is right for you?**


- **Choose Concourse** if you want to automate the documentation, journal-entry, reconciliation, and disclosure work around hedge accounting, on top of a valuation engine.
- **Choose Chatham or GTreasury** if you want software paired with expert advisory and outsourced execution.
- **Choose Kyriba** if you want hedge accounting inside a full treasury platform.
- **Choose Bloomberg MARS or Numerix** if your priority is the valuation and effectiveness-testing engine.
- **Choose Hedgebook** if you are an SME stepping up from spreadsheets.
- **Choose Derivative Path** if you are a bank or heavy interest-rate hedger.


A common 2026 stack pairs a specialist valuation-and-testing engine with an agent layer that automates the documentation, entries, and disclosures around it, rather than one tool trying to do everything.


## **Frequently asked questions**


### **What is hedge accounting software?**


Hedge accounting software automates the requirements of applying hedge accounting under ASC 815 or IFRS 9: designation and documentation, effectiveness testing, derivative valuation, journal entries, and disclosures. It is sold as a standalone platform, a module inside a treasury system, or a software-plus-advisory service.


### **What is the difference between ASC 815 and IFRS 9?**


ASC 815 is the US GAAP standard and is more prescriptive; IFRS 9 is the international standard and is more principles-based, focusing on the economic relationship between the hedge and the exposure. Most hedge accounting software supports both. Note that FASB's ASU 2025-09 relaxes several ASC 815 constraints for periods beginning after December 15, 2026.


### **Can AI do hedge accounting?**


AI agents can automate much of the workflow around hedge accounting, assembling documentation, preparing effectiveness-testing inputs, generating journal entries, reconciling positions, and drafting disclosures. They do not replace the derivatives-valuation engine or the professional judgment on designation and effectiveness, which remain specialist and human territory.


## **The bottom line**


The best hedge accounting software depends on whether your gap is workflow, valuation, or expertise. Chatham and GTreasury bring advisory depth, Kyriba brings a full TMS, Bloomberg MARS and Numerix bring the valuation engine, and Hedgebook fits smaller teams. With ASU 2025-09 reshaping ASC 815, it is a good moment to reassess.
